selected_evidence.summary: Shows the persistent cron entry, correct ownership/mode, exact schedule and command, and enabled/active crond before and after reboot.
Shows timestamped output in the requested log and a successful post-reboot append from one line to two.

Captures the healthy baseline and old boot ID, safe reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, recovered system/crond state, persistent schedule and prior log data, and successful post-restart execution.
